ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 dated 15 November 2022, effective 1 March 2023; Government Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP dated 28 April 2023 on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing; Articles 4.5 and 4.6 defining foreign investment and foreign investor; Article 27 on charter capital contribution and legal capital licensing); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020 (Articles 32-37 on market entry conditions; Decree No. 128/2024/ND-CP on credit institution capital requirements and licensing for payment intermediary and card scheme membership; Circular No. 09/2025/TT-NHNN of the State Bank on testing sandbox for fintech and digital payment activities (expected effective pilot framework for virtual card issuance by licensed non-banks); ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, legal representatives, proposed directors, and card program sponsors against the following: Vietnamese domestic PEP list maintained by the Anti-Money Laundering Information Center (AMLIC) under Decision No. 13/2023/QD-TTg; United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list (binding on Viet Nam under Chapter VII and implemented via transgovernmental directives); OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons list (best-practice mandatory for international card networks to avoid Mastercard/Visa exclusion); EU CFSP sanctions lists (required for any EU corridor fund flows through EVFTA banking channels); Interpol Red Notices and domestic wanted lists of the Ministry of Public Security of Viet Nam; global beneficial ownership registry adverse media and integrity databases (e.g., Dow Jones, World-Check, Bureau van Dijk); and the FATF public list of high-risk jurisdictions. The protocol mandates enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons from sensitive sectors, source-of-wealth verification via audited financial statements and notarized bank letters, negative news monitoring for reputational risks, and ongoing transaction monitoring aligned with the risk-based approach of Decree 19/2023/ND-CP. Final sign-off must be obtained by the AML Compliance Officer of the Vietnamese LLC prior to submission of the Investment Registration Certificate application.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration Portal of Viet Nam (Cổng Thông tin Đăng ký Doanh nghiệp Quốc gia) operated by the Business Registration Agency under the Ministry of Planning and Investment, accessible via dkd.trungboki.quocgia.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Article 39 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP and Law on Enterprises 2020, the Vietnamese enterprise name must be written in Vietnamese script (with possible contextual use of Latin letters for proper nouns, internationally recognized abbreviations, and conventional acronyms), must include the legal entity type suffix 'Công ty TNHH' for a limited liability company, must not be identical or confusingly similar to another registered enterprise, must not duplicate a reserved or protected name, and foreign investment names must display a transliteration or translation into Vietnamese that preserves comprehensibility. Proprietary English brand names may appear as a secondary name in parentheses if the Vietnamese name is provided first. The use of foreign script alone is not permitted as the statutory registered name. All name clearance submissions require a Vietnamese legal translation and consistent transliteration across the Investment Registration Certificate, Enterprise Registration Certificate, tax code file, and banking documents.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: CITING TOKENS OF CONSUMER CREDIT OR CREDIT CARD LEAD GENERATION
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Business Registration Agency refuses an enterprise name, the applicant may file a written complaint with the same DPI within 30 days of the rejection notice. The DPI is required to re-evaluate the name in a 7-day statutory window. A further escalation is available through complaint jurisdiction to the Ministry of Planning and Investment (Business Registration Agency) and thereafter to the Administrative Court under Law on Administrative Procedure No. 24/2015/QH13. For reserved names tied to the Investment Registration Certificate, applicants may resubmit up to 5 times within the 30-day reservation window if the underlying IRC application remains open. In case the name contains a prohibited financial/card token referred to the State Bank of Viet Nam, an explicit in-principle approval letter from the SBV Licensing Department must be attached to the reconsideration request before the DPI re-opening of application.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are generally NOT permissible as sole registered address for a fintech card issuer in Viet Nam. The Law on Enterprises (Articles 29-30) and Decree 01/2021 require a verifiable physical premises address for the head office, service site, and archive storage; Decree 05/2025/ND-CP as applicable requires a licensed payment institution to maintain a physical operational office in Viet Nam, with local management and audit records on site, and the State Bank of Viet Nam requires a dedicated compliance office and server/log presence on national territory. A shared service or virtual office may only be used as a temporary correspondence address pre-licensing, and the company must secure a physical lease before obtaining the Enterprise Registration Certificate and SBV non-bank card-issuer license. For ISIC 6619 corporate virtual card issuance specifically, the Ministry of Public Security and SBV assessment requires evidence of premises adequate for secure data processing, card scheme compliance, and on-site supervisory inspections.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High/Quantified risk of 90-100% for the first year after the SBV non-bank card issuer license is granted, with an estimated 3 unannounced on-site inspections per annum; pre-license phase carries a 65% probability of a DPI physical verification of premises; additionally, Mastercard/Visa operational reviews conduct scheduled and unscheduled site visits at least once every 12 months, and the SBV may deploy joint inspections with the Ministry of Public Security for AML/CFT obligations under Decree 19/2023/ND-CP and Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 46-72 for multi-member limited liability companies; Articles 73-89 for single-member limited liability companies); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 36-38 on Investment Registration Certificates; Chapter III on sectors with conditional market access); Decree 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration (Articles 24-26 on issuance of Enterprise Registration Certificates); Decree 52/2024/ND-CP on Non-Cash Payments (Chapter IV, Articles 19-27 on licensing of intermediary payment services); Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15; Circular 19/2016/TT-NHNN on bank card operations as amended.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (Sở Kế hoạch và Đầu tư), operating through the National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp); for the licensed payment-intermediary activity, the State Bank of Vietnam (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam) exercises the payment-service licensing mandate.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) submitted on the National Business Registration Portal, resulting in the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký doanh nghiệp); the foreign-invested assessment is performed jointly with the Investment Registration Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký đầu tư) already obtained under the Law on Investment.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: General rule: an LLC has no statutory minimum charter capital, but the registered charter capital must be paid in full within 90 days after issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate and the payment date and method must be recorded in the National Business Registration database. Special rule for a virtual card issuing and spend-management fintech: the State Bank of Vietnam imposes a minimum legal capital of VND 50 billion (approximately US$ 2,000,000) for licensed intermediary payment services covering payment instruments and card-related issuing/acquiring support; the capital must be fully disbursed, deposited in the company's corporate bank account, and evidenced by an independent audit certificate of capital disbursement attached to the payment-license application.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING MEMBERS OF [COMPANY NAME] (VIETNAM) LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY (THE 'COMPANY'), ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS VOTING AT THE FIRST CORPORATE CONSTITUTIVE MEETING HELD AT [CITY], VIET NAM ON [DATE]. RESOLVED: 1. SUBSCRIPTION OF SHARE CAPITAL — That the charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND [________________] (in words: ____________________), divided into the membership capital portions set forth in the Company Charter, and that each founding member subscribes to his/her/its respective capital portion in full; capital contributions shall be made in lawful Vietnamese Dong to a dedicated capital escrow account of the Company opened at a licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam, and the payment instructions approved by the General Director together with the bank credit confirmation shall constitute sufficient evidence of capital contribution. 2. ADOPTION OF THE COMPANY CHARTER — That the Company Charter, as submitted, is approved and adopted, and the powers, governance rules, internal management structure and member rights contained therein are confirmed. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE — That the registered office of the Company is fixed and established at [full address, including province/municipality], Viet Nam; the General Director is authorized to execute, deliver, and perform the office lease and associated agreements and to cause the registered address to be filed with the Business Registration Office. 4. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS — That the following individuals shall be appointed as the executive officers of the Company, each by a separate resolution of this constitutive meeting: (i) [Name/ID] as Chairman of the Members' Council; (ii) [Name/ID] as General Director and legal representative; (iii) [Name/ID] as Chief Accountant; and (iv) [Name/ID] as Chief Compliance Officer/AML Officer. Each officer is directed to perform the statutory fiduciary duties, to sign on behalf of the Company within the delegated authority, and to execute all filings required for the lawful establishment of the Company. 5. ESCROW AND CAPITAL MANAGEMENT — That the General Director is authorized to open one or more corporate bank accounts, including the capital escrow account, and to give instructions on the custody, investment, or withdrawal of the paid-in charter capital solely for lawful corporate purposes in accordance with the Law on Enterprises and the Company Charter. 6. REGULATORY LICENSING — That the Company shall pursue any and all permits required by Vietnamese law and by State Bank of Vietnam regulations for the lawful provision of intermediary payment services and virtual corporate card issuing and spend-management solutions, including the SBV intermediary payment service license, card-network (Mastercard/Visa) program participation, and any banking partnership agreement for sponsorship of a card BIN. 7. DELEGATION — That the General Director, together with the Chairman of the Members' Council, is authorized to make any amendments to the charter, to execute the applications, to execute company seal specimen filings, to appoint outside counsel, and to take all other lawful actions necessary to complete the incorporation and regulatory authorization of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for the Foreign-Invested Project
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city where the project is located; if the project is located in an industrial/export-processing zone, the Management Board of the Zone; comments from the State Bank of Vietnam are required for the conditional payment-service business line.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the Investment Project Registration dossier using the National Foreign Investment Information System or accepted hard-copy protocol at the One-Stop Section of the DPI. The dossier must describe the project of an LLC providing virtual corporate card issuing and spend-management as an intermediary payment service, identify the market-access sector under WTO commitments, and demonstrate that the investor is eligible to hold the licensed capital. The DPI will consult the SBV on licensing conditions. No Investment Policy approval is required for this non-concession, non-critical project; only Investment Registration is needed, issued as the IRC. After approval, pay the prescribed fee (if any) and collect the certified IRC.
required_dossiers: Written investment project proposal (covering the project objectives, scale, investment capital, and phasing)
Legal status documents of the foreign investor (certificate of incorporation, passport, or equivalent) legalized/consularized as required
Audited financial statements (or proof of financial capacity) of the foreign investor for the most recent two years
Documents substantiating the projected operating model, including a payment-service business plan and target card-network arrangements
Proposed location evidence (office lease commitment or letter of intent)
Power of attorney to the Vietnamese project authorization representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a written request for supplementation, respond within the stated statutory period (generally 10 working days) by submitting the additional documents; if the IRC application is refused, the applicant may remedy the grounds of refusal and resubmit, or file an administrative appeal against the refusal with the Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee within 30 days from receipt of the refusal, and thereafter may initiate administrative court proceedings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh), Department of Planning and Investment; online submission on the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the IRC already granted, prepare and submit the Enterprise Registration application through the online portal. The system will issue a dossier receipt and the Business Registration Office reviews the dossier for legal completeness and consistency with the IRC. The officers identified in the First Board Resolution must be validly appointed and identified; the General Director's legal representative mandate must be expressly declared. Upon approval, the ERC is delivered electronically; the company's tax identification number is automatically issued by the General Department of Taxation with the ERC. The company then executes a certified copy of the ERC for use in subsequent registrations.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) using the standard form
Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty)
List of founding members (for multi-member LLC) or member's identity dossier (for single-member LLC)
Valid identity documents of the legal representative and authorized officers
Investment Registration Certificate (IRC)
Capital contribution schedule or payment confirmation, if capital is contributed before registration
Lease/office availability approval document for the registered office
Legalization/consularization of foreign corporate and personal documents (notarized Vietnamese translation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected, the DPI issues a written notice stating the legal grounds for rejection; the applicant may amend and resubmit the corrected dossier within 30 days. If issues persist, the applicant may appeal to the Director of the DPI or file a lawsuit at the competent administrative court under the Law on Administrative Procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Carving, Seal Specimen Notification, and Capital Contribution Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The legal representative of the Company and the seal-carving service provider; seal specimen notification is made online to the National Business Registration Portal; the capital contribution bank account is opened at a licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the ERC, prepare and carve the common seal (or, alternatively, adopt a digital seal system as permitted by Article 44 of the Law on Enterprises). The legal representative must submit the seal specimen notification form on the National Business Registration Portal within 15 days from the date the seal is used. Simultaneously, open the corporate bank account at a licensed commercial bank; deposit the subscribed charter capital in full or in accordance with the capital schedule; obtain from the bank a written credit confirmation/transaction proof, which is necessary for the SBV payment-license application. If the company opts for additional foreign currency accounts, open them with the SBV's prior registration if required.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
Seal specimen registration form (Mẫu thông báo mẫu dấu)
Legal representative identity documents
Resolution or authorization for bank account opening
Company Charter and member resolutions governing capital contribution
Bank account opening forms and beneficial ownership declaration (AML compliance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal specimen notification is rejected, correct the typographical/legal inconsistencies and re-file; if the bank declines the account opening due to AML/KYC concerns, supplement the beneficial ownership declaration and source-of-funds evidence, or choose another licensed bank and repeat the procedure. Failure to file the seal specimen within the statutory period is subject to an administrative fine but may be cured by immediate corrective filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, E-Invoice, Labor, and Social Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial/City Tax Department (Cục Thuế) and the General Department of Taxation e-portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn); Department of Labor, War Invalids, and Social Affairs (DOLISA); Social Insurance Agency (Bảo hiểm xã hội).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the electronic tax account using the taxpayer identification number reflected on the ERC; register the electronic invoice method with the tax authority; submit the initial tax declaratory forms and the method of tax calculation (generally corporate income tax under the standard rate, with value-added tax and special sales tax handled under standard rates; confirm whether the payment-intermediary service qualifies for the 10% VAT rate). Register employees and the payroll with the Social Insurance Agency for compulsory social, health, and unemployment insurance. File the labor norm and occupational safety declaration with DOLISA if the company employs hazardous machinery or security/IT infrastructure, and appoint a safety officer. These registrations are prerequisites for lawful recruitment and invoice issuance.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
Tax registration form (issued electronically with the ERC)
Electronic invoice registration form (Đăng ký sử dụng hóa đơn điện tử)
Lease contract and other corporate expense evidence to support the VAT input declarations
Employee list and labor contract templates
Social insurance contribution registration forms for the company and employees
Occupational safety risk inventory and safety officer appointment statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the e-tax account activation fails, re-submit paper-based tax registration to the provincial Tax Department; if the electronic invoice registration is rejected, cure the technical specification or legal representative authorization; for social insurance or labor registration issues, correspond with DOLISA to correct the declared payroll and rectification of any under-declaration to avoid late-filing penalties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: State Bank of Vietnam License for Intermediary Payment Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) – Payment Department (Vụ Thanh toán); appraisal coordinated with the Monetary Policy Department, Legal Department, and the SBV branch at the location of the applicant; final grant by the Governor of the SBV.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and submit to the SBV the application for the license to provide intermediary payment services covering the authorized activities of virtual corporate card issuing, spend management and related payment-support services. The application must state the exact service categories permitted, the technical infrastructure description, and the AML/CFT compliance program. The license cannot be issued unless (i) the applicant is a Vietnamese LLC or JSC established under the Law on Enterprises, (ii) the legal capital of VND 50 billion is fully paid and audited, (iii) the foreign ownership ratio is within the applicable ceiling for payment intermediary service providers, (iv) the information-systems/security plan meets SBV Circular 09/2020/TT-NHNN (as amended), and (v) the legal representative and key officers meet fit-and-proper requirements of the Law on Credit Institutions as applied by analogy. Upon license grant, the company must execute business cooperation agreements with licensed card-issuing banks for BIN sponsorship and apply for program participation with Visa and Mastercard as a program manager; subsequent network certification is required before going live.
required_dossiers: Application form for a license to provide intermediary payment services
Company Charter, Enterprise Registration Certificate, and Investment Registration Certificate
Audit certificate confirming full disbursement of legal capital (VND 50 billion) held in company account
Certificate of no tax/social insurance debt and criminal-record clearance of key officers
Internal payment-service operational regulations, risk-management regulations, and AML/CFT manual
Information-systems architecture and security plan, including data localization and incident response rules
Business cooperation agreement (executed or draft) with a licensed bank for card issuing/BIN sponsorship
Statement of foreign ownership ratio and supporting ownership chart
Undertaking to comply with the Law on Banking Activities and Decree 52/2024/ND-CP
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The SBV is required to issue a single written request for any missing or invalid documents and must issue the license or a written refusal within the appraisal time limit. If the application is refused, remedy the contingencies described in the refusal, re-file a new application, or initiate an administrative appeal to the Minister/Governor within 30 days and thereafter to the administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Physical Premises, Civil Defense, Fire Safety, Environmental Registration, and Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Fire Prevention and Fighting Rescue Police Department (C07) of the Ministry of Public Security for the local fire authority; provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for environmental registration; Department of Labor, War Invalids, and Social Affairs (DOLISA) for occupational safety clearance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For the office and data/server operations, conduct a Fire Safety Design Appraisal (thẩm duyệt thiết kế về phòng cháy chữa cháy) if the premises are subject to statutory fire-safety requirements (buildings with electrical server areas, battery UPS systems, or high-occupancy offices); obtain the Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate (văn bản nghiệm thu phòng cháy chữa cháy) after construction/fit-out. Submit the environmental registration dossier (Đăng ký môi trường) to the District-level DONRE under the Law on Environmental Protection 2020 and Decree 08/2022; this registration certifies that the office-based activity does not generate polluting discharges beyond domestic-scale thresholds. Register the occupational safety/hazardous works inventory with DOLISA and appoint a safety supervisor; provide work-safety training records and arrange for required medical examinations for employees handling servers and electrical equipment.
required_dossiers: Office lease agreement and floor plan showing the server/UPS room locations
Base-building Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate (for the building landlord) and/or project fire-safety design dossier
Fire Safety Design Appraisal application and civil-defense compliance statement
Environmental Registration form (Mẫu đăng ký môi trường) with waste-generation estimates (domestic wastewater, e-waste, UPS batteries)
Occupational safety risk inventory (for machinery/electrical equipment) and safety supervisor appointment
Employee records and safety-training certificates
Waste-transport service contract with a licensed waste-collection company (for hazardous e-waste)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If fire-safety acceptance is rejected, rectify the non-conforming fire-protection equipment or evacuation design and re-inspect; if environmental registration is returned, correct the waste-flow data and resubmit; if DOLISA queries the occupational safety inventory, file a supplementary list of machines and the safety procedures. All such administrative queries are cured by timely response and continued, demonstrated compliance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam) – Payment Department (Vụ Thanh toán); auxiliary physical licensing by the Fire Prevention, Fighting and Rescue Police Department (C07) under the Ministry of Public Security, and the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for environmental registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: License to Provide Intermediary Payment Services (Giấy phép hoạt động cung ứng dịch vụ trung gian thanh toán) issued under Article 25 of Decree 52/2024/ND-CP, read together with a card-issuing bank partnership agreement for BIN sponsorship and Mastercard/Visa program-management contracts for the virtual corporate card products.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) / Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) – Environmental Registration subsystem (Đăng ký môi trường).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-risk services category – Environmental Registration (Đăng ký môi trường) only; full Environmental Impact Assessment Report (Đánh giá tác động môi trường) is not triggered because the activity is an office-based technology and payment-service operation without production plants, mineral extraction, or large-scale infrastructure.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater from the office must comply with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT (national technical regulation on domestic wastewater) before discharge to public sewers; any standby generator or cooling-tower stack emissions must comply with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT (industrial emissions for CO, NOx, SO2, and particulate matter); hazardous wastes (UPS batteries, electronic waste, toner cartridges) must be transferred to licensed hazardous-waste treatment facilities and documented on the hazardous-waste manifests required by Decree 08/2022/ND-CP; ambient noise at the site boundary must meet QCVN 26:2010/BTNMT.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Appraisal and Acceptance Certificate under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP (including the server room and UPS room design with approved fire-extinguishing systems); the building landlord must provide the base building fire-safety acceptance certificate; the company itself must obtain the premises acceptance certificate for its leasehold floors. Civil-defense compliance includes a business continuity and incident-response plan registered with the fire police, closed-circuit security recording, and employee safety drills. Occupational clearance: DOLISA registration of the hazardous machinery/electrical inventory (server equipment, UPS systems), mandatory safety-training program, appointment of a safety officer, and annual medical examinations for IT and facilities staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) under the Ministry of Finance of Viet Nam; official portal: https://thuedt.gdt.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-invested LLC obtains a Tax Identification Number (MST) automatically upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate by the Department of Planning and Investment. Thereafter, the enterprise must complete tax registration with the local tax authority (Cục Thuế) to activate its tax file, register the method of VAT accounting, obtain an electronic invoice registration number, and provide supporting documents including the investment registration certificate, company charter, and legal representative identification. For entities engaged in virtual card issuing and payment intermediary activities, a separate license from the State Bank of Vietnam is required before carrying on operations; the tax ID remains contingent on lawful establishment and licensing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections are available under Vietnamese tax law. The entity is automatically classified as a taxable resident enterprise subject to Corporate Income Tax on worldwide income. Available mechanisms include election to apply CIT preferential rates based on sector and location (e.g., high-tech, supporting industries, economic zones) and election of the VAT calculation method (deduction method versus direct method) where eligible.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 1 billion (annual revenue threshold for mandatory VAT registration under the deduction method; enterprises below the threshold may voluntarily register or be subject to the direct method)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Since 1 July 2022, Vietnam mandates 100% electronic invoices with mandatory tax authority verification codes for all enterprises (Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC). Invoices must be transmitted to the GDT system in XML format via certified software; each invoice is assigned a unique verification code (mã của cơ quan thuế). No real-time per-transaction clearance is required for standard invoices, but no-coded invoices (hóa đơn không có mã) are only allowed on the direct method. APIs are required for some high-volume business-to-business models, and all invoices must be digitally signed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods, and services supplied to foreign organizations/individuals used outside Vietnam, are eligible for 0% VAT. This includes offshore card processing, financial switching, and B2B services provided by a Vietnamese entity to non-resident clients, provided the service is consumed outside Vietnam, contracts are with non-residents, and supporting documents evidence the offshore delivery. Zero-rating is also available for goods sold to export processing enterprises (EPE) and for goods/services used in export processing or bonded warehouses.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading (or Airway Bill, or international transport documents)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank confirmation of foreign currency receipt
Documents evidencing foreign counterparty and utilization/consumption outside Vietnam (for services)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The tax authority will claw back VAT previously zero-rated if export documentation is incomplete, payments are not repatriated within 180 days, or the services are found to be consumed in Vietnam. Penalties include: 10% late-payment interest per annum on outstanding tax; administrative fines of 20% of underdeclared tax for incorrect declarations; up to VND 200 million (and confiscation of invoices) for serious violations; and criminal prosecution under the Penal Code for tax evasion, with imprisonment of up to 7 years and penalties up to 1.5 times the evaded amount. VAT inputs corresponding to disallowed zero-ratings are also reversed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) and the Foreign Exchange Control Department under SBV; delegated administration also exercised by the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) for FDI registration and by licensed commercial banks as authorized foreign exchange banks (authorized banks).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnam maintains a managed float regime with the Vietnamese Dong (VND) not fully freely convertible. Current account transactions are generally convertible subject to SBV regulations, while capital account transactions require strict licensing, registration, and underlying economic substance. Foreign-invested enterprises (FIEs) may open VND and foreign currency accounts at authorized banks, but foreign currency lending and settlement are restricted to permitted purposes. Profit remittance abroad is permitted after audited financial statements, completion of annual corporate income tax (CIT) finalization, fulfillment of all tax obligations, and submission of the audited financial report plus remittance application to the tax authority; remittance is made through an authorized bank. Capital contribution must be made fully in accordance with the investment registration certificate (IRC) and enterprise registration certificate (ERC), with the equity capital transfer and loan principals/interest remittance subject to registration with the SBV via the authorized bank. A virtual card issuer's cross-border fees, interchange settlements, program manager fees, and network assessment charges are classified as current-account services that may be remitted abroad upon invoices and underlying contracts; however, any deemed capital export, foreign loan, or intercompany funding must be registered under the Foreign Loan Registration regime. Practical hurdles include documentation-heavy remittance files, SBV's ex-post inspection powers, delays in obtaining tax confirmation for profit remittance, and the requirement that all foreign currency inflows from exports or card scheme settlements in VND be channeled through an authorized bank; the State Bank may impose temporary suspension of foreign currency payments in cases of national foreign reserve stress.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SBV Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN (as amended by Circular 02/2018/TT-NHNN and relevant regulations), exporters are generally not required to compulsorily sell all export proceeds; they are required to remit export proceeds into a foreign currency account at an authorized bank within 90 days of actual export (or within the time limit specified by contract, but not exceeding 180 days, and certain exceptions may extend to 360 days with SBV approval in specific sectors). Since Circular 15/2015 abolished the mandatory surrender ratio for exporters, the effective conversion obligation is limited: exporters must convert foreign currency to VND only for the foreign exchange balance requirement or as otherwise directed by the SBV in emergency situations, or when the exporter elects to sell to the authorized bank. For a virtual card issuer, settlement and clearing flows received from international card networks (Mastercard/Visa) are not classical 'export proceeds' but must still be credited to the entity's foreign currency account and, when converted to VND for operational payments, must be converted through an authorized credit institution using an applicable exchange rate, with proper declaration on the foreign exchange surveillance form and underlying clearing statement retained for six years.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam JSC (BIDV)
Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank (MB Bank)
Tien Phong Commercial Joint Stock Bank (TPBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Program Management Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for a locally licensed principal entity: offshore digital EMI providers (e.g., UK-licensed EMIs, EU EMI-licensed issuers, or Singapore-licensed payment institutions) are not permitted to maintain a branch or provide payment card issuance services in Vietnam without a local license, and they are not authorized banks under SBV law. Offshore EMIs may only serve as unlicensed foreign technical service providers (card program management, BIN sponsorship, processing, compliance software) and may not hold Vietnamese client funds or issue VND-denominated virtual cards as principal. A BIN sponsorship arrangement must be structured so the local LLC remains the principal card issuer under a licensed Vietnamese bank's acquiring/issuing sponsorship or under the fintech's own e-money/payment intermediary license from the SBV; otherwise the activities constitute unlicensed banking/payment intermediation under the Law on Credit Institutions and Decree 52/2024/ND-CP, exposing the entity to criminal and administrative liability. BIN sponsorship by foreign entities is permissible only if the foreign sponsor is itself an authorized payment institution in its home jurisdiction and the actual settlement occurs through a licensed Vietnamese authorized bank; even then, the SBV requires prior notification/approval for cross-border payment services and every VND clearing must occur in-country.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: High: Vietnamese law and standard SBV enforcement practice require that the legal representative or an authorized director physically appear before the bank's AML/KYC officer for the original onboarding interview for a corporate account, especially for a fintech/card-issuing client classified as high risk. While some commercial banks provide digital account opening for domestic companies, a foreign-invested LLC with a high-risk scope (ISIC 6619) will be subject to enhanced due diligence (EDD) requiring physical presence of at least one director at the bank's head office or branch for identity verification, sighting of original passports, and execution of the account mandate. The physical interview may be waived or mitigated only where a recognized diplomatic legalization/apostille process is completed and the bank accepts a remote video KYC procedure under its internal risk appetite; however, the SBV's AML Law (Law on Prevention of Money Laundering 2022) and Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN do not explicitly authorize fully remote onboarding for high-risk non-resident corporate customers, so the prudent baseline is physical attendance. Where any director is unable to appear, the LLC must grant an explicit board resolution authorizing a named Vietnamese-resident officer or external lawyer to attend with original notarized powers of attorney, but legal representatives remain personally accountable for anti-money-laundering disclosures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fully digital cross-border card issuer with no local banking license and no physical office in Vietnam
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IRC/ERC evidencing licensed payment intermediary or e-money license from SBV; lease agreement for registered head office; Vietnamese staffing contracts for compliance and AML officers; audited financial statements; board resolution on AML/CFT governance; organizational chart evidencing local decision-makers; six-month business plan; regulatory license status confirmation from SBV; and evidence of ultimate beneficial ownership chain with passport copies and police clearance certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: BIN sponsorship from a foreign fintech/EMI without an SBV payment intermediary license
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly executed BIN sponsorship agreement with international card scheme (Mastercard/Visa) and accredited sponsor bank; sponsor bank's authorization in its home jurisdiction; SBV notification of cross-border payment arrangement; opinion of Vietnamese counsel confirming the arrangement does not constitute deposit-taking or e-wallet issuance in Vietnam; card program flowchart showing that all VND settlement occurs at a Vietnamese authorized bank; and licensing declaration under Decree 52/2024/ND-CP / Law on Credit Institutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-transparent beneficial ownership or nominee shareholder structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficial ownership register filed with the National Business Registration Portal; full UBO identification (individuals holding 25% or more or exercising control); chain-of-ownership diagrams to ultimate natural persons; notarized passport copies; utility bills with residential address; tax identification numbers in home jurisdictions; bank and professional reference letters; declaration of source of wealth and source of funds; and signed commitment to promptly update SBV and the bank on any ownership changes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High expected transactional velocity and cross-border settlement of card transactions without underlying commercial documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed card program rules and merchant/expense policy; counterparty onboarding and due diligence files; anticipated transaction monitoring and suspicious transaction reporting (STR) procedures compliant with Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN; sanctions screening framework (UN, OFAC, EU, and Vietnam sanctions lists); historical transaction volumes if applicable; independent audit of the transaction monitoring system; and contractual undertakings from card program managers or agents to maintain all settlement data for at least five years.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Remittance of card program management fees, scheme fees, and technology royalties abroad
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid cross-border service agreements with itemized fee schedules and transfer-pricing documentation (Form 01 and TP report under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP); invoices and debit notes; bank settlement statements from Mastercard/Visa; customs or e-invoice evidence of services actually performed; CIT withholding tax payment confirmations; audited documentation proving services are taxable in Vietnam or exempt under the applicable double tax agreement; and engagement of a licensed accountant to certify FX remittance purpose codes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity capital must be contributed by the foreign shareholders through the capital account held at an authorized bank established in Vietnam, registered with the SBV in the foreign direct investment (FDI) capital account monitoring system. The authorized bank receives the foreign wire (SWIFT MT103) with purpose code addressing 'Direct investment equity contribution' and must match the amount to the IRC-registered charter capital; the LLC must maintain a separate VND current account and a foreign currency account for current-account operational funds. The capital injection must be reported via the e-degree/information system of the SBV using the FDI enterprise's enterprise identification code; the bank issues a capital receipt confirmation (Xác nhận góp vốn) after checking that the remitter matches the shareholder of record, the reference is made to the IRC/ERC, and no money laundering red flags are triggered. It is not permissible to inject equity through third-party or intercompany netting without SBV approval. The loan or equity portion may instead be recorded as a shareholder loan subject to a foreign loan registration and must be routed through the borrower's foreign currency account with a purpose code 'Private sector external borrowing - direct lending'.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Permitted clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 direct telegraphic transfer through an authorized Vietnamese bank for service fees, licensing royalties, card scheme settlement, program management fees, and vendor payments, with mandatory decoding into the proper FX purpose code and supporting contract; (2) Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) issued via SWIFT MT700 for physical import trade in card hardware if applicable, with bill of lading and documents presented under UCP600; (3) cross-border payment card scheme settlement via Mastercard/Visa clearing messages (ISO 8583 / ISO 20022) submitted through an authorized acquiring/sponsoring bank that nets the VND positions and converts through the interbank FX market; (4) domestic direct debit, NAPAS payment gateways, and QR/ACH rails for VND disbursements to Vietnamese merchants/suppliers; and (5) approved escrow or trust accounts for pass-through settlement only if not constituting deposit-taking. MT103 remittances above USD-equivalent thresholds require the bank to perform EDD, check the transaction against SBV Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN and the State Bank reporting thresholds, and for payments to tax haven jurisdictions the bank may require enhanced documentation. All outbound trade disbursements must be executed strictly after the corresponding tax withholding obligations (Foreign Contractor Tax, VAT, or CIT on outbound payments) are satisfied or documented as exempt, and the entity's auditor and the bank's compliance officer must approve the underlying economic substance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/VND deliverable forward contracts executed between the LLC and a Vietnamese authorized bank, with underlying, contract term, and trading purpose fully documented and settled by physical delivery of VND against USD.

FX swaps between the LLC and an authorized bank in Vietnam, including simultaneous spot and forward trades for working capital management, provided the notional and tenor are matched to actual commercial cash-flow exposure.

Cross-currency swaps (USD/VND or USD/foreign currency) with an authorized credit institution where the VND leg is registered as a derivative transaction with the SBV and hedges a documented commercial loan or card settlement exposure.

Interest rate and currency swap transactions under master agreements (ISDA/ISEMDA or Vietnam Master Agreement) executed by an authorized bank, subject to bank credit approval and the absence of any speculative (non-hedging) purpose.

Onshore purchasing of USD against VND only at the authorized bank's listed buying/selling rates within the official daily band; use of offshore NDF (non-deliverable forward) contracts referencing USD/VND is generally prohibited for Vietnamese resident enterprises unless specifically permitted by SBV, and any offshore hedge that is in substance a forward tied to VND may be void or unenforceable in Vietnam. Treat NDFs as not permissible unless socio-economic underlying necessity and SBV direct authorization are first obtained, in which case the hedge must be routed through an authorized bank or licensed securities broker.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report / Corporate Annual Return (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the licensing province; filed online through the National Enterprise Registration Information System under the Ministry of Planning and Investment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 January of each year covering the preceding calendar year (Decree 01/2021/ND-CP, Article 17)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 10,000,000-20,000,000 (~USD 400-800) under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; two consecutive years of non-filing places the LLC in 'inactive enterprise' status and exposes it to DPI administrative strike-off and revocation of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business License Fee (Lệ phí môn bài) — annual franchise levy on registered charter capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department / Tax Sub-Department under the General Department of Taxation (GDT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 January; newly established enterprises pay within 30 days of Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day, administrative fines up to 1-3 times the omitted fee, and coercive collection measures including bank account seizure if the obligation remains unpaid after tax authority demands.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual CIT Finalization Return and Audited Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) / Provincial Tax Department via the national eTax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the last day of the third month following the fiscal year-end (31 March for calendar-year filers); audited financial statements attached to the finalization dossier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on outstanding tax; late-filing administrative penalties up to VND 25,000,000 (~USD 1,000); chronic failure allows tax authority lien/compulsory collection and is a disqualifying factor for the SBV payment intermediary license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment / Investment Registration Agency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Quarterly within 15 days after each quarter-end; consolidated annual position embedded in the Annual Enterprise Report due 30 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP for investment reporting violations; repeated default triggers investment certificate inspection and possible suspension of investment activities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Report and Beneficial Ownership (UBO/KYB) Data Refresh — required for SBV-licensed virtual card issuing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) — Anti-Money Laundering Department / Banking Supervision Agency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual report submitted by 15 January following the report year, with UBO/CDD files refreshed at least annually and on triggering events (per AML Law 2022 and Decree 116/2016/ND-CP)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: SBV administrative fines up to VND 2,000,000,000 (~USD 80,000) for serious AML reporting defaults; license suspension or revocation of the payment intermediary/card issuance authorization.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies irrespective of size/turnover to (i) every foreign-invested enterprise under the Investment Law (Decree 01/2014/ND-CP, Article 37); (ii) all SBV-licensed credit and payment intermediary institutions, including virtual card issuers; (iii) public/listed companies and enterprises meeting the capital or revenue thresholds set out in Decree 174/2016/ND-CP on the Law on Independent Audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnam Accounting Standards (VAS) as prescribed in Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC, supplemented by SBV/MOF accounting circulars for payment institutions; IFRS is permitted for consolidated financial statements of qualifying parents and approved entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Viet Nam does not operate a standalone annual UBO register filing. The FDI LLC must include an updated member/shareholder and capital schedule in the Annual Enterprise Report to DPI; every capital/unit transfer must, at minimum, update the Register of Members within 15 days and comply with investment registration procedures where foreign investment is involved. As an AML-obliged virtual card issuer, the LLC must re-identify and confirm UBO data at least annually and on material events under the AML Law 2022 and Decree 116/2016/ND-CP, and evidence such refresh to the SBV.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Foreign-invested enterprises operating in qualifying high-tech, software, or large-scale manufacturing sectors may access a preferential CIT rate of 10% for 15 years, with a 4-year CIT exemption and 50% reduction for up to 9 years under Decree 218/2013/ND-CP and Law on Corporate Income Tax 14/2008/QH12. Entities located in qualifying economic zones or industrial parks may enjoy additional incentives including reduced rates of 10% for up to 15 years or 17% for 10 years. A Limited Liability Company engaged in virtual card issuing under ISIC 6619 is generally subject to the standard 20% rate unless specific investment promotion criteria are satisfied.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02/TNDN (annual finalization CIT return) and Form 01/TNDN (tentative quarterly CIT payment declaration). Filed through the General Department of Taxation electronic portal at https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn using an electronic tax transaction account (eTax).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly tentative CIT declarations and payments; annual finalization return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly tentative tax returns and payments due no later than the 30th day of the first month of the following quarter. Annual finalization return and payment due on or before the 90th day after the end of the fiscal year (generally 31 March for a calendar-year taxpayer).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Specifies the fiscal/tax year covered by the annual finalization return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the calendar year or approved fiscal year end date as stated in the investment registration certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enterprise name, tax identification number (MST), address, and business lines.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the local branch or foreign contractor registration MST; the LLC must be registered with the VN tax authority before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total net revenue from sale of goods, services, and virtual card program fee income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize card issuance fees, interchange revenue, and merchant service charges; cross-border digital services must follow Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC allocation rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income exempt from CIT, such as certain government debt interest or qualifying capital gains.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-VN sourced income not attributable to a permanent establishment may be excluded; substantiate with DTA analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible ordinary and necessary business expenses with lawful invoices and vouchers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductibility requires legally valid Vietnamese invoices (hoa don), payment via bank transfer, and compliance with Circular 96/2015/TT-BTC cap on advertising/sponsorship (10% of total deductible expenses).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Losses from prior years up to five years may be offset against current taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses must be carried forward continuously and cannot exceed the five-year limit; no carry-back is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after deduction of expenses and loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recompute using foreign-currency exchange rates as published by the State Bank of Vietnam at transaction date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable statutory or preferential CIT rate (20% standard).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim preferential rates only with investment certificate approval; otherwise use 20%.
Pay in VND even for foreign-owned LLCs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxes paid abroad on foreign-source income, creditable under Circular 151/2014/TT-BTC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: DTA relief available for foreign tax paid in treaty jurisdictions; provide certified tax payment documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax due after crediting tentative quarterly payments and foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Settle any shortage before the annual deadline; refund requests require a separate application procedure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment of CIT attracts interest at 0.03% per day on the outstanding amount. Late filing penalties: if filed within 10 days late, warning; 11–20 days, 400,000 VND; 21–30 days, 800,000 VND; 31–90 days, 1,500,000 VND plus 15% of tax due if under-declared; over 90 days, 2,500,000 VND plus 20% of undeclared tax, capped at 50% of under-declared tax. Tax evasion penalties range from 1 to 3 times the evaded amount; criminal sanctions apply for repeated or large-scale evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Foreign corporate shareholders in a Vietnamese LLC are not subject to a separate dividend withholding tax upon distribution of after-tax profits; dividends are paid out of after-tax CIT earnings without additional withholding. However, the transfer of profits abroad is subject to administrative conditions and creditor protection rules.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke treaty benefits (including reduced dividend WHT, royalty WHT, or interest WHT), the non-resident recipient must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the competent tax authority of the residence jurisdiction and submit it to the Vietnamese withholding agent before the payment date. The Vietnamese payer files Form 01/NT and Form 02/NT through the eTax portal, attaching the TRC, legal DTA text, and evidence of beneficial ownership. The tax authority has up to 30 days to review; simultaneous filing with tax finalization is allowed under Circular 05/2017/TT-BTC and Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on payments to non-residents: royalties for use of IP, trademarks, software licenses, and technology: 10% WHT on royalties (combined with Foreign Contractor Tax, effective total up to 20% on gross payments unless treaty reduced). Interest paid to non-resident lenders: 5% statutory WHT on interest under Law on Foreign Contractor Tax / Law on CIT. Under the Vietnam–Singapore DTA or equivalent applicable DTA, royalty WHT may be reduced to 10% or 5% in certain circumstances, and interest WHT may be reduced to 5% or 10% depending on the treaty and recipient type; the reduced rate applies only after TRC and beneficial ownership approval.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: A taxpayer is required to prepare a Local File and Master File (TP Documentation) if the related-party transaction turnover in a year exceeds 50 billion VND or total related-party transaction value exceeds 30 billion VND, and the taxpayer does not fall below the annual revenue and transaction thresholds specified in Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, Article 18. For smaller taxpayers, a TP form (Form 03-1/TNDN) must be submitted with the annual CIT return. Related-party transactions with low-value thresholds are exempt from full documentation if revenue is below 100 billion VND and total related-party transaction value is below 5 billion VND.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam applies an economic-substance-based analysis through the related-party transaction principles of Decree 132/2020/ND-CP; taxpayers must demonstrate that the transaction substance, functions, assets, and risks align with the arm's length result. Although Vietnam does not apply the OECD-style Economic Substance Regulations applicable in UAE/BCI jurisdictions, the General Department of Taxation (GDT) may recharacterize arrangements lacking commercial rationality and substance; for fintech virtual card issuers, substance review focuses on actual card processing activities, talent, risk management, and decision-making functions in VN. The 'substance over form' doctrine also applies under Law on Tax Administration Article 19, allowing the tax authority to disregard transactions without bona fide business purpose.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally underreporting revenue from card usage fees, interchange fees, or foreign transaction fees; fabricating invoices; misusing the tax-loss carryforward; or artificially shifting profits to related entities without arm's length pricing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount, plus late payment interest at 0.03% per day. Criminal liability under the Penal Code 2015 (amended 2017) Article 200 for tax evasion: from 100 million to 1.5 billion VND evaded, up to 3 years' suspended imprisonment; 1.5 to 4.5 billion VND, 3 to 7 years' imprisonment; above 4.5 billion VND, 7 to 12 years' imprisonment and fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, general directors, chief accountants, and legal representatives can be jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid taxes if they knowingly approved false declarations or diverted assets to frustrate collection. Travel bans are issued under the Tax Administration Law for legal representatives with outstanding tax debts. Criminal conviction exposes directors to imprisonment, fines of up to 5 billion VND and civil restitution of defrauded State revenues.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Registering a VN LLC solely as a pass-through entity for intragroup card management fees, without having any employees, premises, bank accounts, or operational oversight in Vietnam, while booking all material revenue remotely.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The GDT may recharacterize or disregard the entity's transactions, deem a permanent establishment of the foreign parent, impose 20% CIT on income deemed earned in VN, and deny deductible intercompany fees; penalties for incorrect transfer pricing documentation can be 1 to 3 times the adjusted tax deficit, plus late payment interest, under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP. The LLC may face license revocation for failing to meet the operating purpose for which it was licensed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who are signatories to sham transactions are subject to administrative fines, and if the GDT proves intent to conceal a benefitted foreign principal, they may be prosecuted as accomplices to tax evasion; travel bans are applied for tax arrears, and courts may issue a prohibition from holding management positions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Unlicensed Money Services (Fintech Red Flag)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing corporate virtual cards, processing spend loads, or settling card transactions on Mastercard/Visa rails without a statutory non-bank payment intermediary license from the State Bank of Vietnam (SBV), or failing to implement AML/KYC requirements under the Anti-Money Laundering Law 2022.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unlicensed payment operations are subject to administrative fines under SBV regulations of up to 2 billion VND and shutdown of the operation. Violations of AML obligations carry up to 500 million VND in fines; serious violations are criminally prosecuted as illegal money transmission under Penal Code Article 329, subject to imprisonment of up to 10 years and property confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior managers can be criminally charged, personally fined, and imprisoned; SBV inspectors may suspend banking relationships and block personal bank accounts of directors involved in layering or undisclosed ownership arrangements; civil liability for customer losses triggered by unlicensed issuance flows to the entity and directors jointly.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging excessive management fees, technology royalties, or software licensing fees to the Vietnamese LLC to render it perpetually loss-making while diverting profits to an offshore affiliate; also misuse of intercompany funding by thin capitalization artificially avoiding debt/equity limits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP and Decree 126/2020/ND-CP, tax authorities may make an upward adjustment of taxable income, disallow excess interest deductions (with a 30% EBITDA cap), impose penalties of 20% of the under-declared tax amount plus interest, and require updated TP documentation. Fines for non-submission of TP documentation or failure to justify arm's length prices range from 1 to 5 times the tax underpayment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and chief financial officers may be personally liable for penalties as control persons in administrative penalty decisions; criminal liability arises if the transfer pricing manipulation is classified as tax evasion; travel bans against directors are common enforcement tools where the LLC is unable to pay the adjusted tax, and directors may be required to personally remit withholding taxes on distributed funds under joint liability provisions.
